note: Animation catalogues are per body type, not per species. Every humanoid (human, Vulcan, Klingon, …)
shares the humanoid set; a non-humanoid monster uses its own set. Species still pick appearance
(race mesh, hair, uniform) on the shared humanoid rig.
sheetIds list which characterSprites.json sheets (plus procedural 3dOnly extras) belong to the set.
An empty sheetIds list means the set is reserved but has no clips yet.
